title: regional-quiesce-and-immutable-residency-snapshots-for-private-deployments
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement an orchestrated 'regional quiesce' flow for Private/VPC deployments that produces immutable, signed residency snapshots and a provenance bundle for compliance audits. Snapshots capture node placement, IP ranges, storage retention settings, KMS key IDs, and policy-bound retention windows at a point-in-time before any controlled regional failover or maintenance. The feature should be automatable via the Private control plane and emit tamper-evident artifacts that can be ingested by the compliance reporting pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Control plane can trigger a regional quiesce that drains new inference requests while allowing in-flight requests to finish within configurable grace period
System emits a residency snapshot JSON plus a signed digest (PKI-signed bundle) that includes node metadata, timestamps, retention settings, and policy bindings
Snapshot artifacts are stored immutably (append-only) in the customer’s configured audit bucket or our evidence store and are discoverable via the Console and API
Automated test simulates a planned failover and verifies the snapshot contains correct KMS key IDs and per-tenant retention flags
Telemetry shows quiesce duration, number of affected requests, and any failed snapshot uploads; SLA for snapshot creation success is 99.9% during scheduled quiesces
implementation_notes: Add quiesce API endpoint to private control plane: POST /v1/residency/quiesce with payload {region, grace_period_seconds, reason, retention_override}

Quiesce operator will coordinate: 1) route weight -> 0 for region, 2) signal serving runtime to stop accepting new sessions, 3) wait for KV cache flush / in-flight tokens up to grace period, 4) collect node metadata and retention bindings

Generate a signed provenance bundle: include snapshot.json, manifest.txt, and a signature created by platform signing key stored in HSM (customers may opt to use customer-managed key via KMS integration)
Store snapshot in an append-only archive with object lock semantics (S3 Object Lock or customer equivalent); include content-addressed checksum for tamper detection
Extend existing audit export pipeline to pick up 'quiesce' artifacts and wire into the compliance-reporting job that produces the reviewable PDF bundle
Edge case: if an unplanned regional failure occurs, mark snapshot as 'partial' with best-effort collected fields and flag for manual review
Security: ensure only authorized org admins can trigger quiesce; pre-flight check verifies no concurrent upgrade or rollback flows are active
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal alpha): enable for internal private clusters in staging; validate artifacts and signing flow
Phase 2 (customer beta): enable for two pilot customers with non-critical workloads; collect feedback on artifact schema and upload destinations
Phase 3 (general availability): enable toggle in Console with RBAC, expose API and SDK helper, include documentation and runbook
Migration: backfill recent controlled maintenance windows by generating synthetic snapshots where possible to seed evidence store for pilot customers
telemetry: trace.quiesce.flow_id for correlation with traces and incidents
